name: Whiskey Slim's Lost Grog
summary: In the pirate haven of Booty Bay, Whiskey Slim finds himself in dire trouble with his captain. During a violent storm off the coast of the Hinterlands, Slim tapped into a seized crate of Pupellyverbos Port, only to lose the bottles to the churning sea. To escape a brutal flogging, he needs an adventurer to retrieve his misplaced grog.

sections.title: A Tempest off the Hinterlands
sections.body: Whiskey Slim's crew was battling severe weather off the Overlook Cliffs, with the shore of the Hinterlands looming nearby, when the sailor sought a dose of liquid courage. His ship had seized a crate of Pupellyverbos Port from a privateer vessel sailing toward Stormwind. Facing waves that threatened to swallow their ship whole, Slim broke into the captain's crate, but a sudden surge swept the bottles right over the side.

sections.title: A Sailor's Desperation
sections.body: Back in Booty Bay, the clock is ticking down as the ship prepares to weigh anchor. Slim dreads facing the cat-o'-nine-tails once his commanding officer realizes the confiscated port is missing. He seeks someone willing to bring back twelve bottles before his theft comes to light.

faq.answer: Whiskey Slim is a sailor residing in Booty Bay who has landed in deep trouble after losing his captain's stolen alcohol during a sea squall.

faq.q: Where did the grog come from?
aliases: where did slim get the grog
faq.answer: The crate of Pupellyverbos Port was commandeered by Slim's crew from a privateer vessel that was on its way to Stormwind.

faq.q: Where did Whiskey Slim lose the bottles?
faq.answer: Slim lost the bottles overboard during a fierce storm off the Overlook Cliffs, near the coast of the Hinterlands, when a massive wave struck the ship.

faq.q: Why does Whiskey Slim need the bottles back so quickly?
faq.answer: His ship is preparing to depart, and once the captain discovers his port is missing, Slim fears he will be punished with a flogging from the cat-o'-nine-tails.
